definitions: A software tool or feature that guides a user through the process of importing data from an external source into an application or database.
An interactive utility designed to simplify the task of bringing external data into a system by providing step-by-step instructions.
examples: Use the Data Import Wizard to upload your customer list.
The Data Import Wizard made the migration process much easier.
I followed the steps in the Data Import Wizard to get the spreadsheet into the database.
